next_movement: Connect additional real systems to the same boundary: Online School should emit/consume shared handoffs instead of maintaining an isolated task model, then use those handoffs alongside Personal Operations in activation projections such as James's ohayo.
walls: Do not redefine A/B as the activation layer, personal planner, task manager, or handoff runtime.
Do not let an activation word invent tasks or mutate state merely by being spoken.
Do not turn James's ohayo route into a rigid hourly schedule; its current projection is tasks/dependencies/blockers only.
Do not collapse notes, tasks, plans, and handoffs into one record type; their relations differ.
Do not expose other actors' tasks through an actor-scoped activation unless an explicit shared relation admits them.
Preserve the existing handoff evidence/provenance contract beneath every activation projection.
